answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a vine bet on surviving 88 epochs of grading, and every bridge settlement recomputes the anchor schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 88 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
